zoe: Quick brainstorm  Sales wants a "Pin Brokerage" concept — basically a marketplace-style offering where customers can buy pin slots (short/long), reserve capacity, and optionally buy migration insurance. Looking for constraints.
mike: Interesting. High-level constraints: reservation complexity, regional residency, and clear SLAs for rollback and migration credits.
ara: From product POV I'd split into two products: Broker Basic (self-serve, 30/90d pins on shared infra) and Broker Plus (180d, reserved capacity, SOW + insurance). Different acceptance gates.
kevin: Ops note: Broker Plus needs capacity reservation and an approval workflow. Also require a deterministic-quant check; if a model can't be quantized deterministically we mark it ineligible for Plus.
zoe: Can we sketch acceptance gates for both tiers? short bullets pls.
mike: Basic: default TTL 90d, preflight quick bench (50 samples), p95 <= 220ms, embedding drift <= 5%. No reserved capacity; migration credits prorated.
ara: Plus: TTL up to 180d, full preflight CI (200 samples), p95 <= 140ms, embedding drift <= 3%, reserved-capacity mapping required, signed SOW, and audit export.
kevin: Add feature flags in registry: broker_eligible, max_broker_ttl, reserved_required, strict_fallback_allowed. Also add insurance_flag for migration_insurance.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-4010: "pin-brokerage-spec + billing mapping" (owners: kevin, ara)
zoe: Migration insurance semantics? legal, any quick thoughts?
legal: Insurance would be contract language with defined payouts (e.g., X days reserved-capacity credit) and conditions (forced retirement, upstream changes). Need clear definitions for "forced retirement" and "material regression."
mike: Bench command to reproduce locally for Plus:
```
bench-run --model rwdx-4b --seq 512 --concurrency 6 --samples 200
```
Include cost_delta check <= 1.6x vs baseline.
ara: Telemetry: broker_pin_p95, broker_eval_fail_rate, broker_fallback_count, broker_insurance_payouts. Export pin_reason and broker_tier to billing. Alert: broker_eval_fail_rate > 2% -> page.
kevin: Emergency unpin runbook must be explicit: suspend pin -> fallback (unless strict) -> communicate -> migrate. Provide API snippet in spec.
zoe: UX: Console marketplace with cards for Basic/Plus, price, region, TTL, and a quick compat check button. For Plus show "request SOW" flow.
mike: Canary plan: 10 customers on Basic, 5 on Plus (mix of regions). Monitor for 30 days. Success = no P1s, eval_fail_rate < 1.5%.
ara: Owners: kevin (infra + registry flags), mike (bench + CI), legal (contract templates + insurance terms), zoe (UX + pricing). I'll compile a one-pager by EOD Wednesday.
legal: We'll draft a short insurance stub and definitions. Also recommend audit retention: 2 years for pin metadata.
zoe: Great. Use this thread for notes. If anyone has objections to the two-tier Broker Basic/Plus split, speak up now. Otherwise I'll move to write the spec. :rocket:
